utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay, let's get going, I've got a hard stop at eleven. Three items: the customer conference, rep sign-ups to host, and the customer newsletter.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Lakshmi, you had thoughts on the conference?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Um, yes. I think we should do the summit again. In person, at the Harborview Hotel, in the ballroom.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Same place as two years ago?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Yes. The ballroom.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I think, maybe, I remember that was a good one? Not sure about the pipeline numbers.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: It was. The summits have generated more pipeline than anything else we've tried, and customers tell us in the survey that they love meeting the product team face to face.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: The big picture is we sell on relationships, so that fits.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: What's the budget?

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Roughly the same as last time. I can send the sheet.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Hold on, sorry. Ivan, did you say it was a good one?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I think, I mean, it felt good. The room was full.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay. I'm in favor. Anyone against?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Not against. Date?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Late November. Okay, so, we're booking the Harborview ballroom for the summit.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: I'll call them tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Perfect. Rep sign-ups, who has it?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I do. We have, I think, thirty-something? Maybe forty?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Thirty-four. I counted yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Thirty-four, right. And we want, what, sixty?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Sixty. Elif, can you push it in the sales channel?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I could write a short ask, if that helps? Maybe in the customer newsletter?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Yes, do that. Newsletter goes out the fifteenth, so draft by the tenth.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Okay, I think I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Should the newsletter mention the date?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Not until the booking's confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: I'll confirm this week.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Anything else? No? Then thanks. Go.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay, before anything else, I got an email from the Harborview yesterday. They're closing the ballroom for renovation through the end of the year. And I called around, and the next best venue wants a deposit that's eighteen thousand over what we budgeted.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Oh no.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Through the end of the year, so no November.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: No November.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I think, maybe, they said that might shift? I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: They said end of year. I asked twice.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Could we just do it in January?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Customers plan budgets in the autumn. January misses the renewal cycle.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: And the eighteen thousand?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Over. On top of what finance already approved.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: That's not happening. Finance would laugh.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: So, with the venue closing and the cost, we can't keep the summit plan as it was. I want to open it back up.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Open it up how? Like, entirely?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: The format. Ideas.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Big picture, we want to keep customers close and still drive pipeline. What about a virtual product showcase? With a small invite-only reception for the top accounts, in our own office. It costs way less than a hotel, we reach customers who can't travel, and the reception keeps that personal touch for the accounts that matter most.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: In the office? How many people?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Thirty, forty.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: That's actually doable. We did a board dinner here for thirty.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Maybe the event platform has a fee? I think maybe four dollars an attendee?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I'll check. It's usually small.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Lakshmi, how do you feel? It was your idea.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Um. I'm a little sad. But the numbers are the numbers. I think it works.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay. Then I'm deciding: we're switching to a virtual product showcase plus a small invite-only reception.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Dates?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Same window, late November. Showcase streams over a week, reception on the last night.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Love it.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Should I cancel the Harborview call?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Don't call them, they cancelled on us. Just send a polite note.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Do we tell the customers? Maybe? In the newsletter?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Yes, but let's get the platform first. Noor, platform by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Got it.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: And rep sign-ups, how many are we at?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Thirty-eight.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Good. Thanks everyone.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay, third meeting, let's go through where we are. Event platform, Noor?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I looked at three. The one I like is four dollars an attendee and handles registration and reminders automatically.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: For how many attendees?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: We're aiming for eight hundred registrants, so about thirty-two hundred.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I think, maybe, that's fine? I remember another vendor wanted seven dollars.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Four is fine.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Sign up for it. Lakshmi, the reception, we need a guest list.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: I have, um, forty-two names. Top accounts by revenue, plus a few renewals at risk.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Forty-two for a room that fits forty. That'll be fine, not everyone comes.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: They always come for the free food.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: I think about thirty will come.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Catering, maybe a local caterer, small plates.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Budget?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Around three thousand for thirty.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Okay. Elif, rep sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Forty-one signed up. Ahead of target for the smaller event, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Great. Ivan, newsletter.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Yes. I wrote the piece about the showcase. Maybe it's a little long? I can cut it.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Send it to me. And put the start date in.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I think the date is the twenty-first? Starting?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: The twenty-second. I wrote it down.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Right, the twenty-second. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: We need product demo clips for the showcase.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I can record them in the office on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I'll help, I'll bring a light.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Also, quick, the office heating. Facilities says it's fixed.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: It was freezing yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: They say fixed. We'll see.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Big picture, are we all set for the reception layout?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Next week. Lakshmi, sketch it.

utterances.speaker: Lakshmi
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Anything else? No. Thanks.
